The predominant sequence transduction models rely on sophisticated recurrent or convolutional neural networks that consist of an encoder and a decoder. The most effective models interconnect the encoder and decoder via a specific mechanism. We introduce a novel, simple network architecture, called the Transformer, which eliminates the need for recurrent or convolutional components and the need for an explicit mechanism to connect the encoder and decoder. This approach results in a highly efficient architecture that can achieve state-of-the-art performance in sequence-to-sequence tasks without the use of any recurrent or convolutional layers.
